verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to deliver a signal, event, or message into a specific already-running Hatchet workflow from an API call, webhook, or another workflow. The bare 'Webhooks' page title and the mention of CEL 'event filters' do not show inbound delivery to a running instance. The RabbitMQ comment describes the engine's internal pub/sub between workers, not a user-facing signaling feature.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I send signals, events, or messages into a specific running workflow from outside — an API call, webhook, or another workflow
